text: Decision: IMPLEMENT (worth pre-v1). #3005 is a real generator-shape gap — the concept-read codegen (#2899) exists to eliminate hand-patching, and Android's guarded `AppHandle::with_app` accessor was locking a whole platform out of it. Closure-mode design is the right one and matches the issue author's proposal. [...] - `crates/nmp-content/schema/embed_sidecar.fbs` + `src/wire/embed_sidecar_fb/{encode,decode}.rs` — FlatBuffers wire union carries the projection cross-FFI; every variant needs a table + encode/decode arm. Regen is gated through `ci/regenerate-flatbuffers.sh`, not raw flatc (repo rule).
